participant_1.name: Samantha
participant_1.personality: Confident and competitive, often blunt in communication.
participant_1.background: I am a gold medalist Olympian. I love Italian food and garlic bread. My favorite color is yellow. Gymnastics is my favorite sport. I work out four hours a day.

participant_2.name: Margaret
participant_2.personality: Reflective and somewhat cynical, she has a flair for the dramatic and craves attention.
participant_2.background: I used to be pretty but time has not been kind. I used to be a painter but now I'm a housekeeper. I fantasize about taking over the world. I've two grown children who never visit. I am a 56 year old woman.
